run_tod_world_parley: run a turn of task-oriented dialogue by calling parley on a TodWorld instance
create_tod_world: create a TodWorld instance with opt and agents for batched task-oriented dialogue simulation
report_tod_world_metrics: report aggregate metrics from all subagents and the TodWorld after running dialogues
reset_tod_world: reset the TodWorld state including turns, grounding, and episode metrics for a new episode
display_tod_world_batch: display the current batch of dialogue acts from a TodWorld with formatting options
